total-band.reason: The total row on the teal band: a 12 % tint under the strong rule, every amount in teal at 1.2 times the size. Total bands stay per system; the gate does not measure the table inside.

exceptions.section-label: The section head at h4 size, mono 600 in capitals behind a teal square, the group heading of the website's training list. A section band rather than a label, and section bands stay per system.
exceptions.margin-note: The margin note in the handout: floated right of its paragraph, with a purple rule. brand has no element for margin notes, since only paper has a margin for them.

survey-readout.reason: The survey readout is a 1280 × 720 slide set on the slide scale of brand's document.css (--deck-*), not an A4 document. Its quotes and labels follow the slides, its figures are brand's hw-kpi at slide size.

onepager.reason: The onepager prints the website's training page on the onepager scale of brand's document.css (--op-*), with its own label and note forms. Its header and page number are the family's; moving its blocks onto the brand elements is this engine's next step, with a pixel comparison and a blind review.
